guidelines.vandalismSanctions: Accounts caught engaging in vandalism or spamming will have their editing privileges revoked permanently without warning, and their changes will be reverted.
guidelines.harassmentBody: Bullying, hate speech, or harassment towards other community members or voice actors will result in an immediate and permanent ban.
guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.noVandalismBody: Deliberately inserting false information, deleting valid data, or corrupting the database is strictly prohibited.
guidelines.noSpeculationBody: Do not guess a voice actor based purely on "voice recognition" unless it's universally accepted or officially confirmed. If you are unsure, mark it for community discussion rather than submitting it as a definitive fact.
guidelines.verifyBody: Ensure that the casting information (who voiced whom) is accurate before submitting it.
guidelines.assumeGoodFaithBody: If someone corrects your contribution, assume they are trying to improve the database, not attack you personally.
guidelines.useRatingBody: If you want to express your opinion on a performance, use the dedicated rating and review features instead of altering factual database entries.
guidelines.thanks: Thank you for helping us build the most comprehensive and accurate dubbing database in the world!
guidelines.constructiveDiscussionsBody: Use the discussion features to resolve conflicting casting info politely. Do not engage in edit wars.
guidelines.welcome: Welcome to DubbingBase! Our platform thrives on community contributions. To maintain a high-quality, reliable, and respectful environment for voice acting enthusiasts and professionals alike, we ask all contributors to adhere to the following guidelines.
guidelines.factualToneBody: When writing biographies or notes, stick to the facts. Avoid expressing personal opinions about the quality of a dub or an actor's performance in encyclopedic fields.
guidelines.citeSourcesBody: Whenever possible, base your contributions on official end credits, verified studio announcements, or direct confirmations from the voice actors themselves.
